library.title: Document library
library.description: Every document you may read, most recently changed first.

project.title: Project {id} documents
project.description: The documents of this project that you may read. A document uploaded here belongs to the project.

recent.title: Recent documents
recent.description: The {count} documents you may read that changed most recently.
recent.toLibrary: See every document in the library

SCAN_PENDING.title: Checking the file for malware
SCAN_PENDING.body: The file was received and is being scanned. Until it is found clean it cannot be downloaded or used as evidence.

CLEAN.title: No malware found
CLEAN.body: The file can be downloaded and used as evidence.

QUARANTINED.title: Malware found: this file is quarantined
QUARANTINED.body: The file is kept for the record but will never be served, downloaded or accepted as evidence. Upload a clean file as a new version.

SCAN_FAILED.title: The file could not be scanned
SCAN_FAILED.body: It stays unavailable until a document manager queues it for scanning again, or a new version replaces it.

unavailable.SCAN_PENDING: Available once the scan finds it clean.
unavailable.QUARANTINED: Quarantined: malware was found. It cannot be downloaded or used as evidence.
unavailable.SCAN_FAILED: Not scanned: it cannot be downloaded or used as evidence.

lookups.unavailable: Document types and classifications could not be read, so a document cannot be described here.
lookups.nonePublished: None is published yet. A master data administrator must publish one before a document can be uploaded.

upload.title: Upload document
upload.body: The file is checked for malware after it is received. It can be downloaded and used as evidence only once it is found clean.
upload.fileHint: One file. Its size and type are checked by the server.
upload.classificationHint: How sensitive the content is. Only people cleared for this classification can read it.
upload.closeWhileScanning: You can close this window: the scan continues, and the document's page shows its result.
upload.watchFailed: The scan result could not be read. Open the document to see it.

replace.title: Upload new version
replace.body: The file becomes the document's next version. Earlier versions, and evidence that relies on them, do not change.

archive.title: Archive this document?
archive.body: An archived document takes no new version and no change. Nothing is deleted: its versions, links and evidence stay readable.

attach.title: Attach a document
attach.body: Choose the document to attach to {target}. Only a document whose latest version is clean can be attached.
attach.quarantined: Quarantined: malware was found. It cannot be attached or used as evidence.
attach.notClean: Not clean yet: it can be attached once the scan finds it clean.

detail.archived: This document is archived. It takes no new version and no change.

versions.title: Version history
versions.description: Every version of the document, newest first. A version never changes once uploaded.
versions.caption: Versions

done.uploaded: The file was uploaded and is being scanned.
done.versionAdded: The new version was uploaded and is being scanned.
done.rescanQueued: The version was queued for scanning again.

problems.notAvailable: This version is not clean, so its content cannot be downloaded or used as evidence.
problems.referenceInvalid: A chosen document type, classification or project is not available. Choose another value.
problems.versionConflict: Another version was added at the same moment. Upload the file again.
problems.payloadTooLarge: The file is larger than the server accepts.
problems.unsupportedMediaType: This type of file is not accepted.
problems.storageUnavailable: Document storage is not available at the moment. Try again later.
problems.archived: The document is archived and takes no change.
problems.notRescannable: Only a version whose scan failed can be scanned again.
problems.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to do this with documents.
